evidence.V1: Front/three-quarter silhouette reads as a grass tuft on a mound; top view reads as a radiating spiky star - recognisable from all angles at 64 px.
evidence.V2: Some hierarchy (mound base, tall blades, short blades) but blades are near-identical wedges and the small blades read as stray shards rather than designed detail.
evidence.V3: Blades are stiff wedge cones with an abrupt tip band; mound is a low polygonal disc - only partly stylised.
evidence.V4: Mound rim has a soft rounded edge but its outline is visibly polygonal (12-gon), blades end in razor tips and the front short blade is a sharp flat shard - inconsistent edge treatment.
evidence.V5: Base close-up shows hard dark intersection seams where blades pierce the mound, faceted blade sides and a shard-like front blade; 224 cross-shell overlaps instead of fused shells.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: one green hue in three values (mound dark, blade mid, tip light); autumn/frost colourways keep the same three-value structure.
evidence.V7: 576 tris vs small target 600 (ceiling 1500) - under target.
evidence.V8: One white LF_VertexColor material matches, but blades are separate shells stabbed into the mound rather than fused smooth organic shells; faceted mound outline.
evidence.V9: Foliage Studio settings correct: Anchored, CanCollide/CanTouch/CanQuery off, Box fidelity, MeshPart white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre.
